slowest_experiments.experiment: Build an isolated executor and a fresh versioned request panel
Bind V644 sources and the exact fourteen-task contract
Prototype a result-resume contract in the live ARC policy
Measure complete in-process constraint cost and parity

summary: Seven compute-bound experiments completed in 72.7 minutes. The 70.42-minute isolated-executor and request-panel task dominated measured wall time; the locked accelerator-idle assessment is false.
bottlenecks_identified: Build an isolated executor and a fresh versioned request panel consumed 70.42 of 72.7 measured minutes, but the timing data does not identify which internal phase caused the delay.
The available timing has no phase boundaries, so setup, execution, waiting, and teardown costs cannot be separated.
Model concurrency and runner-choice receipts are absent, so DualGPURunner eligibility and any missed parallel dispatch cannot be determined.
improvements_suggested: Add phase timers and resumable checkpoints to the isolated-executor and request-panel path so the next long run exposes its costly stage and can continue after interruption.
Capture task-scoped GPU utilization, memory, process, and device samples throughout every compute window instead of relying on one monitor snapshot.
Record model count, concurrency intent, selected runner, and device assignment at launch; use DualGPURunner only when two or more models are loaded in parallel.
Add readiness-aware placement for independent compute tasks so a second available GPU can be used when concurrent work actually exists.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Instrument the 70.42-minute isolated-executor and request-panel task with phase timers and resumable checkpoints.
Join experiment phases to task-window GPU and process telemetry.
Emit model-cardinality, runner-choice, and device-assignment receipts, then schedule concurrent ready work across available GPUs.
meta_reflection: Disk-mtime reconstruction reveals runtime concentration but not its cause. A point-in-time GPU snapshot and absent launch-cardinality receipts cannot establish sustained accelerator efficiency or a DualGPURunner miss, so the estimated savings remains 0%.
